translate_en|mods/ContextMenuCleanup/42/: Hides, removes, rearranges and renames entries in right-click context menus by name.
Enable mod
Untick to turn the mod off without clearing anything below. Context menus are then left exactly as the game built them.
Move Grab Corpse into Grab
Puts "Grab Corpse" inside the "Grab" submenu as "Corpse", next to everything else you can pick up.
Hidden
Hidden entries
Separate entries with a semicolon. Matching is on the text you see in the menu and ignores capitalisation. Start an entry with ~ to match anything containing it. This applies to every option below.
Entries listed here are moved into a "Hidden" submenu pinned to the bottom of the menu, so they stay reachable while getting out of the way. Example: Sleep;Take Nap;~Teleport

Move entries under another entry with Entry>New Parent, separating each pair with a semicolon. The new parent keeps whatever it already did and gains a submenu holding the moved entry. When no entry in the menu carries that name, one is created where the first moved entry sat. An old parent left with nothing below it is removed as well.
Moved entries

Check Doors>Door turns "Check Status > Check Doors" into "Door > Check Doors". Grab one>Grab;Grab half>Grab;Grab all>Grab collects the three into a new "Grab" entry. Both sides are matched anywhere in the menu, including inside submenus.
Removed entries
Entries listed here are removed from the menu entirely, even from the "Hidden" submenu. Use this for entries you never want to see anywhere.

Rename entries with Old Name>New Name, separating each pair with a semicolon. Start the old name with ~ to swap only that part of the entry and keep the rest, such as the furniture name after "Push". The lists above keep matching the name the game gave the entry.
Renamed entries
Cards (No Deck Here)>Cards renames that entry. ~Push>Shove turns "Push Low Bench Trailer" into "Shove Low Bench Trailer", and does the same for any other furniture you push.
Submenu name
The name of the submenu that holds the hidden entries. Leave empty to use the default "Hidden".
Context Menu Cleanup
Title case every entry
Capitalises the first letter of every word, so "Walk to" becomes "Walk To". Only the first letter of each word is changed, so item names, acronyms and words like "Can't" keep their spelling.
